newsitem.title: USA: Wyo. Bridger 550 MW coal unit seen down until Sat.
newsitem.headline: Wyo. Bridger 550 MW coal unit seen down until Sat.

text.p: The 550 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the Jim Bridger coal-fired power plant in Wyoming is expected to restart Saturday after being shut Sunday for unplanned repairs, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Tuesday.
The plant's 550 MW unit 2 remains off-line through the end of the month for scheduled maintenance, while the plant's other two 550 MW units were operating normally, they said.
The Bridger plant is owned by PacifiCorp and Idaho Power Co, but officials at the companies do not comment on plant operations.
